clusters.title: `ImportError: cannot import name '_check' from 'sglang.kernels.ops.moe.smallm_moe_gfx950'` — 47 legs, 3 workflows, gfx950 only

fix_prs.author: michaelzhang-ai
fix_prs.title: [Fix] [AMD] kernels: Import the HIP launch helpers from jit.utils.hipcc in smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
The first failure is D (07:12 UTC). Every MI35x/MI355X leg that loads an FP8 block-scale linear has crashed since then, at server warmup or decode CUDA-graph capture, on all three ROCm lanes.
No gfx942 leg is affected.

Main HEAD [`3438ed66`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/3438ed660dad26a83ed93f6c066f2a50d76507b0) still has the broken import at `python/sglang/kernels/ops/gemm/smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950/__init__.py:10`.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]`: a semantic merge conflict.

[`956b9a24`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/956b9a24eecae92f935672224f8a9561135ebc2b) ([#42229](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42229), merged 05:32 UTC) imports `_check`, `_hip_lib`, `_hipcc` and `_Kernel` from `smallm_moe_gfx950`.

[`693d3333`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/693d33330647c57f82e09ac39a34122fa46b5763) ([#45112](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45112)) had already moved those helpers to `kernels/jit/utils/hipcc`.
The last passing runs lack #42229, and every failing run includes it.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: none found. The crash hides everything that would run after it, so other gfx950 changes in the window are unchecked, for example the aiter pin bump [`131c42ba`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/131c42ba339b5e83d6d0772060a97f426ca2e33a).

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ✅ [#45676](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45676) (open since 2026-10-21 22:33 UTC, `blocked`). It imports the helpers from `jit.utils.hipcc` instead. Chase review.
`python -c "from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm import smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950"` on HEAD reproduces the error without a GPU.
After the merge, rerun one DSV4-Pro MI35x leg and one disagg leg to expose any masked failure.
